pageProps.title: Finnmark Mushroom Postcard
pageProps.review: Location of the Finnmark Mushroom Postcard. The address is Kaisvingen 8, Behrens plass, Kirkenes, Finnmark. If it doesn't appear on its own, turn on your seedling detector and look around while moving little by little.
pageProps.content: Around autumn in October 2026, here is the Finnmark Mushroom Postcard. The mural was surprisingly cute, so I sent an expedition to get a postcard. If I get a chance next time, I'll look for another pretty spot nearby as well.
